datasets.why_related: Much of Burkina Faso’s population lives in rural areas where agriculture and village activities shape daily life. Rural population data helps explain the social and economic context behind the village scenes shown in the VR video.

datasets.title: Tourism And Cultural Heritage (Cambodia)

datasets.title: Tourism And Natural Landmarks (Canada)
datasets.why_related: Natural landmarks like Niagara Falls attract millions of visitors each year. Tourism data helps explain how famous natural sites contribute to Canada’s economy and global tourism industry.

datasets.title: Urban Population Growth (China)
datasets.why_related: China has experienced massive urban growth over the past few decades. Urban population data helps explain the scale of city expansion, high-rise construction, and dense urban life visible in the VR video.

datasets.title: Forest Area And Biodiversity (Costa Rica)
datasets.why_related: Costa Rica is famous for its rainforests and biodiversity. Forest area data helps explain how much of the country’s land is covered by forests and why conservation plays a major role in protecting ecosystems.

datasets.why_related: The VR video shows Havana’s streets, buildings, and everyday urban life. Urban population data helps explain how many people live in cities and how urban growth shapes housing, transportation, and public spaces.
